import sys

def compute_brain_latencies(n, p):
    # Initialize the parent array where parent[i] will store the parent of brain i
    parent = [0] * (n + 1)
    # Initialize the depth array where depth[i] will store the depth of brain i
    depth = [0] * (n + 1)
    
    # The first brain is the root and has depth 0
    parent[1] = 1
    depth[1] = 0
    
    # Process each brain addition
    latencies = []
    for i in range(1, n):
        current_brain = i + 1
        parent_brain = p[i]
        
        # Find the depth of the current brain
        current_depth = depth[parent_brain] + 1
        depth[current_brain] = current_depth
        
        # Find the lowest common ancestor (LCA) of the current brain and its parent
        lca_depth = 0
        while current_brain != parent_brain:
            if depth[current_brain] > depth[parent_brain]:
                current_brain = parent[current_brain]
            elif depth[current_brain] < depth[parent_brain]:
                parent_brain = parent[parent_brain]
            else:
                lca_depth = depth[current_brain]
                break
        
        # The latency is the distance from the current brain to its LCA plus the distance from the parent brain to its LCA
        latency = (depth[current_brain] - lca_depth) + (depth[parent_brain] - lca_depth) + 1
        latencies.append(latency)
        
        # Update the parent of the current brain
        parent[current_brain] = parent_brain
    
    return latencies

    latencies = compute_brain_latencies(n, p)
    
    print(" ".join(map(str, latencies)))
